verdict.rationale: The heavy-output performance half of the story is well supported. The project says it consistently beats competing terminals on the vtebench throughput benchmark, and several independent users call it the fastest terminal they have used, including a hands-on `find /Applications` comparison where Alacritty did well against iTerm2, Terminal and Hyper. However, nothing in the pack states that rendering is GPU-accelerated, so that core element of the story rests on no evidence. Missing for 10: any first-party or independent evidence of GPU/OpenGL rendering, documentation of rendering architecture or latency under sustained output, and recent independent benchmarks (the community reports are mostly years old, and one older thread reports 'pty reader' panics).
